# XeraFun Poker

> Free single-player Texas Hold'em web game with advanced AI. Sub-project of XeraFun (https://xerafun.com).

- **Game URL**: https://poker.xerafun.com
- **Platform**: https://xerafun.com
- **Features**: Single-player, intelligent AI opponents, Monte Carlo odds, mobile-first, no download or registration required.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/xerafun/x-texas-holdem
